title: Nvidia-Backed Lumentum Sees Opto-Parts Capacity Sold Out to 2029
key_facts: Lumentum's optical components are 'completely sold out' through early 2029, according to its CEO Michael Hurlston.
Lumentum cannot meet about 70% of demand for some products through next year and 30% for some others through 2028.
Six months ago Hurlston said Lumentum was on track to sell out its capacity by 2028.
Nvidia invested $2 billion in Lumentum earlier this year, along with rival Coherent.
Lumentum supplies advanced indium phosphide devices for high-speed cloud computing and data transmission.
Analysts on average expect Lumentum's sales to more than double this year.
